_meta.northstar: Passkey-first hyperscaler identity/KYC with statutory identity-proofing and compliance evidence modeled as API/queryable evidence artifacts, not Korean legacy UX.

No manual transcription of PDF tables when machine/OCR extraction is required
No claim that passkeys alone satisfy statutory KYC or Korean 본인확인기관 requirements

contract.unknown_policy: unknowns must be an explicit array on every source and backlog row; empty array means no unknowns found in this planning extraction, not legal approval
contract.freshness_policy: each source and backlog row carries a cadence; blocked/unresolved sources refresh monthly until resolved; official fetched sources refresh at least quarterly or on regulator update
contract.owner_policy: owners are accountable teams/roles, not individual people, because this artifact is durable planning source-of-truth
contract.state_policy: state=blocker means row-level policy, certification/readiness, launch, or evidence-acceptance claims fail closed until the row is resolved; state=allowed_unknown permits bounded planning/crosswalk inventory only and still forbids readiness or certification claims.
contract.claim_ceiling_policy: This artifact may claim source-index/planning coverage only. It cannot claim KISA/KMCC designation, ISMS-P certification, CSAP certification, PCI DSS Level 1 readiness, US/EU obliged-entity launch readiness, PQC deployment readiness, WebAuthn PQC readiness, production readiness, or regulatory certification.
contract.source_extraction_queue_policy: source_extraction_queue rows are extraction work records only. They may carry official source metadata, hashes, unresolved reasons, and bounded normalized summaries, but they must not hand-transcribe row/table text or create policy/runtime/control claims before the referenced source rows are machine-extracted and reviewed.

claim_ceiling.freshness_cadence: review on every source-index update and at least monthly while source_blocker_register has open rows

Downstream work may use open allowed_unknown rows for bounded planning and section/article crosswalk preparation only.
